knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read data
```{r packages}
Zambia_raw <- 
  read_dta("Data/Raw/Zambia/EXPRESS SECTIONS.dta")
```

## Yoink data we want
```{r packages}
Zambia_filtered <- Zambia_raw[,c(1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 12, 13, 90, 93, 96, 98, 109, 120, 121, 127, 128, 129, 146, 147, 
                                 163, 320, 331, 332, 336, 333, 344, 364, 365, 368, 369)]
```

## Save as csv
```{r packages}
write.csv(Zambia_filtered, "Data/Processed/Zambia_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
